questions.stem: A carbon centre has three sigma-bond directions, no lone pair, and participates in one pi bond. Translate this description into a qualitative local orbital arrangement and check that the orbitals used in the sigma and pi parts have not been counted twice.

answer.summary: sp2 accounting is three hybrid orbitals plus one residual p. A p function already mixed into a hybrid is not simultaneously counted as an additional residual orbital.

reasoning_route.action: Start from four carbon valence-basis functions.
reasoning_route.why_valid: The second-period basis is one 2s plus three 2p.
inputs: A carbon centre has three sigma-bond directions, no lone pair, and participates in one pi bond. Translate this description into a qualitative local orbital arrangement and check that the orbitals used in the sigma and pi parts have not been counted twice.
reasoning_route.output: Four inputs; three sigma directions and one pi role required.

reasoning_route.action: Mix only the functions assigned to sigma directions.
reasoning_route.why_valid: One s plus two p makes three in-plane sp2 hybrids.
inputs: Four inputs; three sigma directions and one pi role required.
reasoning_route.output: Three hybrids; one p remains outside the mixing.

reasoning_route.action: Assign the residual p to the pi role.
reasoning_route.why_valid: It is perpendicular to the sigma plane and can overlap laterally with a suitable neighbour.
inputs: Three hybrids; one p remains outside the mixing.
reasoning_route.output: Three sigma hybrids + one residual perpendicular p.

reasoning_route.action: Check against sp and sp3 allocations.
reasoning_route.why_valid: Those alternatives account for two hybrids plus two p, or four hybrids plus zero p.
inputs: Three sigma hybrids + one residual perpendicular p.
reasoning_route.output: All totals are four; no function is simultaneously a hybrid input and an extra residual p.

answer.check: Changed check: sp accounting gives two hybrids plus two residual p; sp3 gives four hybrids plus zero residual p.

answer.summary: CH4, NH3, H2O have four introductory domains but tetrahedral, pyramidal and bent nuclear shapes respectively.
